{{Quote|All who follow me come from disparate backgrounds, possess varying ideologies... but our purpose is singular. We will do anything to prevent Manaan's life force&mdash;every defenseless being, every precious resource&mdash;from draining away.|[[The Conservator]]|<ref name="TOR:ACP" />}}
The '''Syphus Collective''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] isolationist group present on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Fanatical isolationists, led by a zealot who calls himself 'The Conservator.' He preaches that non-native influence is poison to Manaan's virtues. The extremists attack any Selkath who associate with 'outsiders.'&thinsp;|[[Shak Los]]|<ref name="TOR:ACP" />}}
The Syphus Collective was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] isolationist group with a wide range of beliefs, including religious zealotry towards [[Progenitor]], conservationism, eco-terrorism, traditionalism, and anti-war extremism. Their beliefs were inspired by an [[Ahto University]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Narlan Syphus]], who taught that [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] was a collective organism, and that contact with [[The galaxy/Legends|the wider galaxy]] threatened the "organism." His students formed the collective as a peaceful group that advocated for Manaan neutrality and isolationism. However, when the Manaan government refused their demands to stay neutral in the upcoming [[Third Galactic War]], the group turned to terrorism to achieve its goals.<ref name="Selkath Isolationists: The Syphus Collective"/>

==History==
{{Quote|Together, my people and I protect the seas from outsiders. We fight to keep our home and its innocent creatures free from harm... ...even if it means we must take up arms against other Selkath. My people heed my commands because our beliefs are as one. I have earned their devotion. They will continue my work, even when I am gone.|[[The Conservator]]|<ref name="TOR:ACP" />}}
[[File:Syphus_Collective.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Selkath isolationists in the [[Exploration Dome]]]]
By c. [[3625 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> the organization had occupied the [[Temple of the Progenitor]] in the [[Asutvu Rift]] on Manaan, where it was being led by an individual known as [[the Conservator]].<ref name="TOR:ACP" /> During the [[Invasion of Manaan]], the group attracted more members as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] forces battled to control Manaan's [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] supply. The Sith sent the [[Krallet Division]] to deal with the Syphus Collective; however, they were defeated by the [[Alliance Commander]], who had been sent to deal with the Division by the [[Manaan Special Warfare Group]].<ref name="Retribution in the Rift">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Retribution in the Rift|[[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]}}</ref> 

Beyond the Conservator,<ref name="TOR:ACP" /> members of the Syphus Collective included [[Nundama]], [[Sabo (Selkath)|Sabo]], [[Maki]],<ref name="TOR:ASC">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|Ancient Selkath City|Manaan}}</ref> [[Bodan Siraam]],<ref name="TOR:Fallout">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=heroic|Fallout|Manaan}}</ref> [[Mata (biologist)|Mata]],<ref name="TOR:EttW">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Ear to the Water|Manaan}}</ref> and [[Tilos Pak]].<ref name="TOR:SSJ">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=heroic|Supply-Side Justice|Manaan}}</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
If the Alliance Commander sides with the Imperials, they instead are tasked by [[Shak Los]] with clearing out the Temple so that Shak can smuggle the artifacts in exchange for a map to kolto deposits. Within this mission, the player encounters the Conservator, and can choose to make a deal with him, turning the Syphus Collective into spies for the Sith. However, this upsets Shak Los, and he refuses to give the map, leading to the loss of the kolto deposit. The player can also choose to kill the Conservator.<ref name="TOR:ACP" />
